statutory_dues.text:
The Company has generally been regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues including goods and services tax, provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income tax, sales tax, service tax, customs duty, excise duty, value added tax, cess and any other material statutory dues applicable to it with the appropriate authorities during the year;
